scope: Measurement metadata preflight only; no budget, revenue-grain, credential, DDL or public DTO changes

gemini_adjudication.reason: The source_ref=None crash scenario cannot pass MensuracaoMeta.__post_init__ (contrato_v2.py). SDK fields alone do not establish pixel_id/custom_conversion_id mutual exclusion; the cited campaign page does not prove this adset restriction. Do not alter previously compiled/approved payload semantics from this excerpt alone. Instead check an explicit conversion-to-source mismatch before compilation.
PlanoMetaV2 rejects is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled=True in every current recipe. ABO sharing is not silently enabled. Existing false flag and approved ABO/CBO bid placement remain unchanged.

Financial code deliberately preserves observed partial values with incomplete flags. atribuicao.totalizar checks homogeneous currency/timezone and propagates spend_completo/revenue_completo; early return would hide known expense. No evidence authorizes changing measurement grain or interpreting missing rows as zero.

implemented: Selected pixels with explicit is_unavailable=true and selected custom conversions with explicit is_archived=true or is_unavailable=true are rejected during reference resolution.
Custom conversion event_source_id, when valid and present, must equal the selected resolved source ID for each optimizing adset.
Missing/invalid optional metadata does not manufacture a negative state, firing threshold or local eligibility proof; remote validation remains required.
Unselected unavailable items cannot block selected valid items. Account-scoped opaque references are still recalculated; no raw IDs are added to public responses.
Metadata uses the existing edge requests, not additional requests or persistent caches. Adapter read errors become domain errors understood by compilation routes.
source_limitations: developers.facebook.com custom-conversion reference returned HTTP429; SDK fields were checked directly, but remote account eligibility and delivery were not exercised.

tests.coverage: Explicit pixel/conversion unavailability, archived conversion, matching/mismatching/absent/malformed source metadata, unselected archived item, request counts and domain-error translation; existing contract/catalog/insights/V2-route regressions.
tests.sql_skips: SQL integration tests require separate infrastructure and were not enabled.

remaining: Arbitrary uppercase standard_event is still accepted by backend regex. No undocumented restrictive allowlist was introduced; this needs a separately versioned supported-event contract.
Live Meta read/validate/create not run by this worker; operator plan approval and PAUSED-only creation remain unchanged.
